context: After all dependent remediation and conformance items finish, revalidate their exact heads and verification evidence, run the focused MCP suite plus the broader acceptance/preflight required by the implementation worktree, inspect PR status and review state, and publish only a redacted evidence handoff. Do not remediate runtime code from this gate; return failures to the owning TODO.
description: Final no-publish gate for the adversarial review of the newly implemented MCP v2 PRs. Re-audit the exact current revision and dependent TODO evidence, confirm all option-to-consumer, resource-envelope, deployment-choice, conformance, and capability findings are fixed without unsafe allowlist drift, and keep publication fail-closed until external deployment acceptance is complete. The external acceptance dependency must remain incomplete until mcp-adversarial-review-runtime-remediation-20260813 PR #1716 is merged, rebuilt by immutable registry digest, and included in the bound deployed-endpoint matrix; this transitive gate prevents the release work from advancing on local remediation alone. Focused green tests alone are insufficient.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not declare complete from focused tests while dependent TODOs, CI, review threads, or deployment acceptance remain open
anti_patterns.instead: Require every dependency and external acceptance gate to be complete
anti_patterns.why: A narrow green suite cannot establish release readiness

anti_patterns.dont: Do not merge or publish against an open conformance PR with missing checks or stale baseline evidence
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the gate fail closed and return the gap to conformance work
anti_patterns.why: Missing status evidence leaves the release decision unproven

anti_patterns.dont: Do not use an implicit local tracker fallback
anti_patterns.instead: Use the explicit hosted backend and record only redacted evidence
anti_patterns.why: Local state can diverge from the authoritative hosted plan

item_meta.blocked_reason: Fail-closed after PR #1716 merged as 3ffa5ba0265e065805e28aab6f092682d3039f2a: external acceptance mcp-stateless-external-deployment-acceptance-v2-4 remains incomplete. A corrected immutable image must be built and deployed by an approved external operator, the complete production matrix must pass in one bound redacted transcript, and a named approver must approve it before release-gate w0 may start.

preserves.behavior: No credentials, endpoints, raw logs, or generated binary artifacts are written to source or tracker prose.
No deployment or publication occurs while the external acceptance TODO is incomplete or evidence is stale.
Runtime remediation stays in the owning dependent TODO; this gate records evidence and disposition only.

prior_art.concept: existing external deployment acceptance and release evidence
MCP remote security and no-publish boundary
